arxiv-2012-08123.title: Applicability of the absence of equilibrium in quantum system fully coupled to several fermionic and bosonic heat baths
arxiv-2012-08123.creator: V.V. Sargsyan 1 , A.A. Hovhannisyan 1,2,3 , G.G. Adamian 1 , N.V. Antonenko 1,4 , and D. Lacroix 5
arxiv-2012-08123.description: Abstract The time evolution of occupation number is studied for fermionic or bosonic oscillator linearly fully coupled to several fermionic and bosonic heat baths. The influence of characteristics of thermal reservoirs of different statistics on the non-stationary population probability is analyzed at large times.

arxiv-2107-04906.title: Anisotropic exchange and non-collinear antiferromagnets on a noncentrosymmetric fcc structure as in the half-Heuslers
arxiv-2107-04906.creator: Seydou-Samba Diop, George Jackeli, Lucile Savary
arxiv-2107-04906.description: Abstract One of the signatures of the face-centered cubic (fcc) antiferromagnet as a typical example of a geometrically frustrated system is the large ground state degeneracy of the classical nearest neighbor and next-nearest neighbor Heisenberg (isotropic) model on this lattice.

arxiv-2108-01436.title: Medical Literature Mining and Retrieval in a Conversational Setting
arxiv-2108-01436.creator: Souvik Das, Sougata Saha, Rohini K. Srihari
arxiv-2108-01436.description: Abstract The Covid-19 pandemic has caused a spur in the medical research literature. With new research advances in understanding the virus, there is a need for robust text mining tools which can process, extract and present answers from the literature in a concise and consumable way.

arxiv-2108-09911.title: Black-Box Test-Time Shape REFINEment for Single View 3D Reconstruction
arxiv-2108-09911.creator: Brandon Leung, Chih-Hui Ho, Nuno Vasconcelos
arxiv-2108-09911.description: Abstract Much recent progress has been made in reconstructing the 3D shape of an object from an image of it, i.e. single view 3D reconstruction. However, it has been suggested that current methods simply adopt a “nearest-neighbor” strategy, instead of genuinely understanding the shape behind the input image.

arxiv-2207-02279.title: Leveraging Trajectory Prediction for Pedestrian Video Anomaly Detection
arxiv-2207-02279.creator: Asiegbu Miracle Kanu-Asiegbu, Ram Vasudevan, Xiaoxiao Du
arxiv-2207-02279.description: Abstract Video anomaly detection is a core problem in vision. Correctly detecting and identifying anomalous behaviors in pedestrians from video data will enable safety-critical applications such as surveillance, activity monitoring, and human-robot interaction. In this paper, we propose to leverage trajectory localization and prediction for unsupervised pedestrian anomaly event detection.

arxiv-2310-13171.title: Survival in the Neptune desert: LTT 9779 b kept its atmosphere thanks to an unusually X-ray faint host star 2023 Survival in the Neptune desert: LTT 9779 b kept its atmosphere thanks to an unusually X-ray faint host star – References
arxiv-2310-13171.creator: Jorge Fernández Fernández, Peter J. Wheatley George W. King James S. Jenkins
arxiv-2310-13171.description: Abstract The Neptunian desert is a region in period-radius parameter space with very few Neptune-sized planets at short orbital periods. Amongst these, LTT 9779 b is the only known Neptune with a period shorter than one day to retain a significant H-He atmosphere.

arxiv-2404-12042.title: Exploring Boundaries and Intensities in Offensive and Hate Speech: Unveiling the Complex Spectrum of Social Media Discourse
arxiv-2404-12042.description: Abstract The prevalence of digital media and evolving sociopolitical dynamics have significantly amplified the dissemination of hateful content. Existing studies mainly focus on classifying texts into binary categories, often overlooking the continuous spectrum of offensiveness and hatefulness inherent in the text.

arxiv-2407-04482.title: Controlling Whisper: Universal Acoustic Adversarial Attacks to Control Multi-task Automatic Speech Recognition Models
arxiv-2407-04482.creator: Vyas Raina, Mark Gales
arxiv-2407-04482.description: Abstract Speech enabled foundation models, either in the form of flexible speech recognition based systems or audio-prompted large language models (LLMs), are becoming increasingly popular. One of the interesting aspects of these models is their ability to perform tasks other than automatic speech recognition (ASR) using an appropriate prompt.

arxiv-2407-17972.title: Strong Embeddings of 3-Connected Cubic Planar Graphs on Surfaces of non-negative Euler Characteristic
arxiv-2407-17972.creator: Meike Weiß, Alice C. Niemeyer
arxiv-2407-17972.description: Abstract Whitney proved that 3 3 -connected planar graphs admit a unique embedding on the sphere. In contrast, Enami investigated embeddings of 3 3 -connected cubic planar graphs on non-spherical surfaces with non-negative Euler characteristic. He established that such an embedding exists if and only if the dual graph contains a particular subgraph.

arxiv-2412-16274.creator: Jacek Jendrej, Andrew Lawrie
arxiv-2412-16274.description: Abstract . We consider a real scalar field equation in dimension 1 + 1 1+1 with an even, positive self-interaction potential having two non-degenerate zeros (vacua) 1 1 and − 1 -1 . Such a model admits non-trivial static solutions called kinks and antikinks.

arxiv-2502-20871.title: Time-optimal problem in the space of probability measures
arxiv-2502-20871.creator: Yurii Averboukh, Ekaterina Kolpakova
arxiv-2502-20871.description: Abstract This paper focuses on the value function in the time-optimal problem for a continuity equation in the space of probability measures. We derive the dynamic programming principle for this problem. In particular, we prove that the Kruzhkov transform of the value function is a unique discontinuous viscosity solution to the corresponding Dirichlet problem for the Hamilton–Jacobi equation.

arxiv-2505-19313.title: Concept Reachability in Diffusion Models: Beyond Dataset Constraints
arxiv-2505-19313.creator: Marta Aparicio Rodriguez, Xenia Miscouridou, Anastasia Borovykh
arxiv-2505-19313.description: Abstract Despite significant advances in quality and complexity of the generations in text-to-image models, prompting does not always lead to the desired outputs. Controlling model behaviour by directly steering intermediate model activations has emerged as a viable alternative allowing to reach concepts in latent space that may otherwise remain inaccessible by prompt.

arxiv-2508-15051.title: Robust Estimation Under Heterogeneous Corruption Rates
arxiv-2508-15051.creator: Syomantak Chaudhuri, Jerry Li, Thomas A. Courtade
arxiv-2508-15051.description: Abstract We study the problem of robust estimation under heterogeneous corruption rates, where each sample may be independently corrupted with a known but non-identical probability. This setting arises naturally in distributed and federated learning, crowdsourcing, and sensor networks, yet existing robust estimators typically assume uniform or worst-case corruption, ignoring structural heterogeneity.

arxiv-2602-08012.title: A Unified Density Operator View of Flow Control and Merging
arxiv-2602-08012.creator: Riccardo De Santi, Malte Franke, Ya-Ping Hsieh, Andreas Krause
arxiv-2602-08012.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Riccardo De Santi, Malte Franke, Ya-Ping Hsieh, Andreas Krause. pmc-10651478.title: A molnupiravir-associated mutational signature in global SARS-CoV-2 genomes
pmc-10651478.creator: Theo Sanderson, Ryan Hisner, I’ah Donovan-Banfield, Hassan Hartman, Alessandra Løchen, Thomas P. Peacock, Christopher Ruis
pmc-10651478.description: Molnupiravir, an antiviral medication widely used against severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2), acts by inducing mutations in the virus genome during replication. Most random mutations are likely to be deleterious to the virus and many will be lethal; thus, molnupiravir-induced elevated mutation rates reduce viral load1,2.

pmc-11419459.title: Clinical observation of low temperature plasma ablation combined with collagenase injection in lumbar disc herniation
pmc-11419459.creator: Yulin Zhang, Qifan Fang, Yongming Zhao, Ying Yang
pmc-11419459.description: To observe the effect of low temperature plasma ablation combined with collagenase injection on lumbar disc herniation. 90 patients with lumbar disc herniation admitted to the pain department of our hospital and receiving surgical treatment from April 2021 to April 2023 were included in this retrospective study, and were divided into 2 groups according to different treatment plans.

pmc-11470559.title: Predictors of trastuzumab-induced cardiotoxicity among racially and ethnically diverse patients with HER2-positive breast cancer
pmc-11470559.creator: Anna Vaynrub, Leila Mishalani, Jayant Raikhelkar, Katherine D. Crew
pmc-11470559.description: BackgroundWhile trastuzumab has been shown to improve disease-free and overall survival in patients with HER2-positive breast cancer, it may also cause trastuzumab-induced cardiotoxicity (TIC). Although racial and ethnic minorities are at higher risk for cardiovascular disease (CVD) compared to non-Hispanic Whites (NHW), limited data exists on TIC incidence in diverse multi-ethnic populations.

pmc-11590532.title: Comparison of the prevalence and associated factors of chronic kidney disease diagnosed by serum creatinine or cystatin C among young people living with HIV in Uganda
pmc-11590532.creator: Esther M Nasuuna, Laurie A Tomlinson, Robert Kalyesubula, Chido Dziva Chikwari, Barbara Castelnuovo, Yukari C Manabe, Damalie Nakanjako, Helen A Weiss
pmc-11590532.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). IntroductionYoung people living with HIV (YPLHIV) are at increased risk of developing chronic kidney disease (CKD) which is associated with high mortality and morbidity. Early diagnosis is important to halt progression. We aimed to estimate the prevalence and factors associated with CKD among YPLHIV in Kampala, Uganda, and to compare serum creatinine and cystatin C for early diagnosis of CKD in this population.MethodsA cross-sectional study with YPLHIV aged 10 to 24 years was conducted in seven HIV clinics.

pmc-11716837.title: Synaptic proteins in pre‐symptomatic Alzheimer's disease: genes implicate synaptic biomarkers to the early detection of cognitive decline
pmc-11716837.creator: Jiarui Ao, Anne Labonté, Cynthia Picard, Ann Brinkmalm, Kaj Blennow, John CS Breitner, Henrik Zetterberg, Sylvia Villeneuve, Judes Poirier, PREVENT‐AD Research Group
pmc-11716837.description: BackgroundThe heterogeneous etiology of “sporadic” Alzheimer’s disease (sAD) includes genetic influences. To better understand synaptic dysfunction in AD pathogenesis, we used protein quantitative train loci (pQTL) assessments and a polygenic risk score (PRS) to examine the relationship between synaptic integrity and longitudinal cognitive performance in the presymptomatic phase of the disease.

pmc-12370948.title: A novel, synthesized, amphiphilic ethylene glycol squalene derivative suppresses BBN-induced bladder carcinogenesis
pmc-12370948.creator: Keisuke Sano, Masanobu Shiga, Farhana Ferdousi, Hiromichi Sakurai, Kazuki Hamada, Kozaburo Tanuma, Satoshi Nitta, Yoshiyuki Nagumo, Shuya Kandori, Akio Hoshi, Hiromitsu Negoro, Bryan J Mathis, Jun Miyazaki, Tran Ngoc Linh, Takashi Arimura, Hiroko Isoda, Hiroyuki Nishiyama
pmc-12370948.description: Squalene, a natural triterpene with antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunostimulatory properties, holds promise for cancer therapy. Here, we examined a previously developed, diethylene glycol derivative of squalene (SQ-diEG) and investigated its in vivo anti-carcinogenic effects in bladder cancer. C57BL/6 mice were treated with 0.025% N-butyl-N-(4-hydroxybutyl) nitrosamine (BBN) to induce bladder cancer, with SQ-diEG or PBS (control) administered orally from Week 0.

pmc-12658673.creator: Liang Gao, Zhi Zheng, Xin-Zhu Lin, Wei Shen
pmc-12658673.description: This cohort study investigates the association between antenatal corticosteroids and bronchopulmonary dysplasia in very preterm infants and whether respiratory distress syndrome and invasive mechanical ventilation mediate the outcomes. pmc-12754858.title: The 2019 national health survey: what does it teach us about the epidemiological profile of stroke in Brazil?
pmc-12754858.creator: Jussara Almeida de Oliveira Baggio, Bruna Roberta Lopes do Nascimento, Ariana Figueiredo Suassuna, Lucas Almeida Andrade, Marcio Bezerra-Santos, Letícia Januzi de Almeida Rocha
pmc-12754858.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundStroke is one of the leading causes of death in Brazil, as well as a major cause of disability in the population. Because of this, national surveys are highly relevant for understanding the impact and planning public policies. The aim of the study was to assess the epidemiological profile and associated factors of stroke in Brazil from the 2019 National Health Survey (NHS).MethodsWe conducted an ecological and population-based study using data from the 2019 NHS in Brazil.

pmc-12966541.title: Primary epithelioid angiosarcoma of the vulva: A rare tumor at an unusual site
pmc-12966541.creator: Elizabeta Miovska, Jasmina Dobrevska, Katerina Nikoloska, Bisera Nikolovska
pmc-12966541.description: Epithelioid angiosarcoma of the vulva is an exceptionally rare and highly aggressive malignancy originating from endothelial cells. Its etiology remains unclear, though risk factors such as prior radiotherapy and chronic lymphedema have been identified. We report a case of a 44-year-old woman with no significant medical history who presented with a rapidly enlarging, foul-smelling mass on the right labia majora.

pmc-13077992.title: Carotid artery velocity-time integral variation combined with passive leg raising test to predict hypotension after induction in older patients under general anesthesia: a prospective study
pmc-13077992.creator: Zhiwei Ge, Feifei Qin, Zhongming Lian, Boyan Zhang, Yaru Huang, Jianjun Yang, Dandan Tian
pmc-13077992.description: BackgroundOlder patients are at an increased risk of developing hypotension following the induction of general anesthesia, which is linked to a higher incidence of postoperative complications, mortality, and morbidity. This study aimed to investigate the effectiveness of carotid velocity time integral variation (ΔcVTI) combined with the passive leg raising test (PLR) in predicting hypotension after anesthesia induction in elderly patients.

pmc-13139922.title: Validation of bronchial airway gene expression associated with bronchiectasis in nasal epithelium
pmc-13139922.creator: Whitney Souery, Jason Wong, Alejandro A. Diaz, Ke Xu, Xiaohui Xiao, Hanqiao Liu, Gang Liu, Adam C. Gower, Yuriy O. Alekseyev, Ehab Billatos, Marc E. Lenburg
pmc-13139922.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). ObjectivesExamine the bronchial epithelium-derived gene expression signature of bronchiectasis (BE) in nasal epithelium.MethodsWe studied 220 participants from the Detection of Early Lung Cancer Among Military Personnel study with bulk RNA sequencing of nasal epithelium brushings. Gene set enrichment analysis (GSEA) examined whether genes previously identified as increased or decreased in the bronchial epithelium of individuals with radiologic BE are enriched among genes most altered in nasal epithelium.

pmc-3750319.description: Peer-reviewed research article (PubMed Central). The NF-κB family of transcription factors has an essential role in inflammation and innate immunity. uslaw-usc-t10-s8683.title: 10 U.S.C. § 8683 — Ship overhaul work: availability of appropriations for unusual cost overruns and for changes in scope of work
uslaw-usc-t10-s8683.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t10-s8683.description: United States Code, Title 10 (Armed Forces); Part IV (General Administration); Chapter 863 (Naval Vessels). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Unusual Cost Overruns.— (1) Appropriations available to the Department of Defense for a fiscal year may be used for payment of unusual cost overruns incident to ship overhaul, maintenance, and repair for a vessel inducted into an industrial-fund activity or contracted.
